description: When a source file is ingested, create a Summary object with first sentence and line count.
source_code:
def behavior(event, graph, ctx):
    obj = event['object']
    content = obj.get('content','')
    first = (content.split('.')[0].strip()+'.') if '.' in content else content.strip()
    line_count = len(content.splitlines()) if content else 0
    sid = f"summary-{obj['id']}"
    summary = {'id': sid, 'type': 'Summary', 'first_sentence': first, 'line_count': line_count}
    ctx.emit_object_created(summary)
    ctx.emit_relation_created({'type': 'summarizes', 'from': sid, 'to': obj['id']})

description: When a PatchProposal is created, create an Evaluation if provenance is missing.
source_code:
def behavior(event, graph, ctx):
    obj = event['object']
    changes = obj.get('changes', [])
    missing = sum(1 for c in changes if not c.get('provenance'))
    eid = f"eval-{obj['id']}"
    evaluation = {'id': eid, 'type': 'Evaluation', 'patch_proposal_id': obj['id'], 'passes': missing == 0, 'missing_provenance_count': missing}
    ctx.emit_object_created(evaluation)
